The 2024 Nobel Prize in Literature was awarded to **Han Kang**, a South Korean author. Her alma mater is **Yonsei University**, where she studied and which is one of South Korea's most prestigious SKY universities.

As of April 2025, the current president of Yonsei University is **Yoon Dong-Sup** (윤동섭), who serves as the 20th president of the university.
